title: FormsExpress Platform
period: Software Engineering Manager | Senior Full Stack Developer · Sep 2025 – Present
cardRole: Software Engineering Manager | Senior Full Stack Developer · 2025 – 2026
overview: As a Manager, take full ownership of RUN (BAU) operations, ensuring system stability and reliability. Work in close partnership with the BUILD, Data, Product and Governance teams to drive aligned outcomes. Remain hands-on by contributing to development when appropriate. As a Developer, contributed to the development and ongoing maintenance of the FormsExpress multi-tenant SaaS platform, serving Australian local councils with end-to-end billing lifecycle management.

modules.name: eNotices
modules.description: Full-lifecycle electronic notice delivery system enabling councils to create, validate, approve, and deliver notices (rates, bills) to ratepayers via email, SMS, print, and postal. Includes a staff dashboard and a ratepayer-facing portal.

modules.name: BPay Integration
modules.description: Integrated BPay bill payment processing including biller registration management, automated bill summary generation and batch upload to the BPay API, and bill summary release/sendout.

modules.name: Identity Server
modules.description: Centralized OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider handling authentication, multi-tenant user management, role-based and resource-based permissions, and external IdP federation (Azure AD, Google).

modules.name: FlexiPay
modules.description: Payment processing platform for flexible payment schedules (one-off, direct debit, quarterly) with automated payment execution, daily reconciliation, and Quickstream gateway integration.

modules.name: Bill Archive
modules.description: Dual-DMS document management system integrating modern (Quantum DMS) and legacy (20+ year) storage, with on-demand migration, PDF viewing/editing (PSPDFKit) and parallel search across both systems.

modules.name: DevOps Automation
modules.description: Designed and implemented Azure DevOps Pipelines across all projects - including automating the release notes generation using XplatGenerateReleaseNotes, publishing to Azure DevOps Wikis and Zoho Learn, and sending formatted email notifications.

modules.name: Cassie AI
modules.description:
An AI voice assistant for Australian local councils that answers ratepayer calls 24/7 — resolving enquiries from a per-council knowledge base, capturing callbacks, transferring to the right team, and automatically paging/escalating to on-call staff via SMS, email and Teams with a full audit trail.

Technical: A Sadie/Retell-hosted voice assistant fronting Azure Functions webhooks, with per-council config in Table Storage and Next.js dashboard/admin portals.
